rows.en: Baren: "...We'll be arriving shortly."
Ymir: "R-right.
Then land as inconspicuously as possible."
Baren: "...R-roger... Heh heh heh..."
Clovis: "Well, I'd better get ready.
Everyone, leave the negotiations to me!"
Celica: "..."
Aurelie: "No, I think we'd better not..."
Clovis: "Come on, leave it to me! All right, let's go!"
Touya: "It's about time... Whoa!"
Clovis: "Excuse me."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "What... was that, meow?"
Touya: "What's with that crazy outfit?"
Aurelie: "...Don't ask.
He's completely confident about it..."
Ymir: "A-anyway, everyone, I'm counting on you."
Touya: "R-right..."
Kururu: "Oh, Mr. Clime. Are you all better now?"
Clime: "Yes, thank you.
Thanks to you, Kururu, my wounds have healed. See?
Anyway, where's Thora?"
Kururu: "She's helping get today's delivery ready.
She said there's a meeting afterward, so she might
be a little late today."
Clime: "Hmm... I see. She'll be late..."
Kururu: "That's right."
Kururu: "Who could that be? I'll go see."
Clime: "...Tch."
Kururu: "Coming! Who is it?"
Clovis: "Hi! I'm not anyone suspi..."
Touya: "I told you, didn't I? That outfit screams suspicious."
Clovis: "What are you talking about?! What's suspicious
about this outfit? Anyway, let me try again..."
Arthur: "Yes, yes. You've done enough, haven't you?"
Clovis: "Whoa! What are you doing?! Let go!
I'm not done..."
Aurelie: "...Well, now that the noisy one is gone,
what do we do?"
Kasumi: "Um, how about something like this...?"
Aurelie: "Hmm, will that work?
Well, it might be more reliable than his approach..."
Touya: "Let's give it a try, anyway."
Kasumi: "Um, excuse me... We've come here to do a feature
on the world's little-known hidden wonders.
We're certainly not anyone suspicious..."
Kururu: "A feature?"
Kasumi: "Y-yes! I hear you have some renowned hot springs
here, and it's a wonderful location where people
put living in harmony with nature into practice.
We feel it's our mission to tell people all over the country
about the charms of this village."
Kururu: "Hmm..."
Kasumi: "H-hahaha..."
Kururu: "Staaare...
Oh, well.
You don't look like a bad person."
Kasumi: (...Whew.)
Kururu: "Anyway, there's no point standing out here talking. Come in."
Kasumi: "Huh? Are you sure?"
Kururu: "Yeah. Everyone behind you can come in too."
Kasumi: "Then, thank you for having us..."
Kururu: "Huh? Mr. Clime?"
Kasumi: "Is something wrong?"
Kururu: "Yeah... He's gone... Maybe he's in the bathroom?"
Touya: "Mr. Clime?"
Kururu: "He washed up in the river outside the village a little while ago.
He was here just a moment ago..."
Arthur: "Well?"
Xiujian: "...I can't sense anyone.
Either he's really gone somewhere, or he's fled..."
Kasumi: "...So it isn't always the same people
who make deliveries to that mansion?"
Kururu: "No, it isn't.
And today is the day we deliver food.
Mom's gone to help with that."
Xiujian: "This is our chance."
Arthur: "We should arrange things right away."
Kururu: "...Hey, why have you only been asking about
that mansion? And now that I look, I've never seen clothes
like yours before. Are you really here to do a feature?"
Kasumi: "I-in this line of work, we sometimes need to stand out.
If we wear unusual clothes like these, we're easy to find, right?
That's how we gather all kinds of information."
Kururu: "...Oh, I see. So that's it. I was sure
you were burglars trying to sneak into
that mansion."
Kasumi: "Haha, hahahahaha..."
Kururu: "Oh, Mom! What's wrong?
You said you'd be late today..."
Thora: "Yes, I forgot something...
But more importantly, Kururu, who are these people?"
Kururu: "They said they came to do a feature on the village.
Um... Huh? Come to think of it, I don't know their names yet."
Thora: "Honestly... How many times have I told you
not to let strangers into the house?"
Kururu: "But..."
Thora: "...My name is Thora Burgley.
May I ask who you are...?"
Thora: "...I see. A feature, you say...
But you don't look like you're here for that..."
Touya: 'H-hey, she's getting suspicious.'
Aurelie: 'She's pretty sharp.
That piercing gaze... She's no ordinary woman.'
Fain: (Burgley... I feel like I've heard that somewhere...)
Kasumi: 'Maybe we should tell her the truth after all?'
Touya: 'You're the one who suggested this.'
Ai: 'But we can't just keep lying to her, can we?'
Thora: "...Excuse me."
Touya: "Y-yes!"
Thora: "As Kururu said, you don't look like bad people.
Would you please tell me the truth?"
Arthur: "...It seems we'd better tell her."
Thora: "And please explain the person peeking inside
through that window over there, too."
Aurelie: "...I was wondering where he'd gone, and there he is..."
Ai: "Was Clovis always like that?"
Arthur: "He gets carried away sometimes.
Well, he's just sulking a little.
By tomorrow, he'll have forgotten all about it."
Touya: "R-really...?"
Kururu: "Then I'll go get him!"
Thora: "...I think I understand the situation now.
You don't seem to be lying.
Still, I never imagined you were Spirit Mech pilots..."
Touya: "Oh, but we've just happened to fight the Zigrim army
a lot. It's not like we, uh, see Zigrim itself
as our enemy..."
Thora: "Hehehe... It's all right. There seem to be
all sorts of things said about the Spirit Mechs,
but I've heard that you certainly aren't acting
out of selfish greed. Besides, the people of this village are discreet,
and they sympathize with your ideals. As do I, of course."
Touya: "...Whew."
Thora: "...Very well. I'll help you."
Arthur: "Are you sure?"
Thora: "We too have been suspicious about that mansion.
Why would the Queen of Limberg have
a country house in Zigrim?
In the end, we still don't really know.
The Queen of Limberg who lived there
passed away last year, and nobody had lived there since.
But recently someone moved in again...
To think the Prince of Agaltia was being held captive there.
No wonder that, unlike before,
nobody has seen any of the people living there.
I imagine there were never any servants there to begin with."
Touya: "Then how do you take their orders and stuff?"
Thora: "Deliveries are made on set days. Only on those days
is the gate open. We put the supplies in the kitchen,
and if there's an order slip left there, we take it back.
We just repeat that routine.
Naturally, everyone finds it rather creepy..."
Touya: "So if we went to the mansion instead,
they wouldn't notice?"
Thora: "Yes. It should probably be all right.
I'll help you too.
Taking hostages is an unforgivable act of cowardice."
Fain: "Indeed! What an admirable spirit!
Let us fight together for justice!"
Thora: "Y-yes. If there's anything I can do..."
Touya: "Then let's leave the preparations to Thora,
head back for now, and work out a plan."
Ai: "I'm all for it!"
Kasumi: "Thora, I'm sorry we lied to you."
Thora: "No, I'm the one who should apologize
for being rude. I was certain you were burglars
trying to sneak into that mansion..."
Kasumi: "O-oh..."
Arthur: "Well then, we'll be going."
Kururu: "See you!"
Oswald: "To think I'd run into them here...
And Prince Tix was in Cain's mansion, was he?
That fool Cain probably has no idea that overstepping
his bounds has shortened his own life...
Heh heh heh. With any luck, they'll dispose of Cain for me.
And then..."
Oswald: "Hehehehehe... Kururu..."
Celica: "How did it go?"
Touya: "We couldn't find out whether Tix is there,
but someone's arranging a way for us to get inside."
Celica: "Someone's arranging it...?"
Kasumi: "A woman named Burgley has agreed
to help us. She's making the preparations now."
Celica: "Burgley...? I've heard that somewhere..."
Fain: "Oh, you too, Princess?"
Celica: "Hmm... Well, never mind.
So, how many people can go?"
Kasumi: "Apparently we won't meet anyone at the mansion,
but just to be safe, we'll keep the usual number.
Four of us will go."
Celica: "Four..."
Arthur: "Your Highness, of course, and then myself, Clovis,
and Touya. How does that sound?"
Clovis: "All right! This time I'll clear my name!"
Aurelie: "So you do admit that was a failure."
Clovis: "Well, that's the composure of an adult for you."
Aurelie: "You're just forgetting the bits you don't like, aren't you?"
Clovis: "Urgh..."
Ai: "What do the rest of us do?"
Arthur: "Please stand by in your Spirit Mechs
in case Prince Cain appears."
Fain: "It isn't right for me to stay behind when the Princess is going!"
Celica: "Fain. I'm giving you a special mission.
Stay here and protect Liebhofen.
This is an important mission that only you can carry out."
Fain: "Only I can..."
Celica: "Yes. I want to entrust it to you.
Would that be all right?"
Fain: "...A-as you command!
I, Fain Jin Barion, swear on my life
to carry out your orders!!"
Kasumi: "Let's do our best, Fain."
Fain: "Oh! K-Kasumi is saying that to me...
Ngh! A-all right, I'll do it!!"
Ai: "...He's unbelievably simple-minded."
Fain: "Hm! You there, did you say something?"
Ai: "Don't call me 'you there'! I have a very
'pretty' name: Ai-chan!"
Fain: "...Then have a safe journey.
Leave everything to me while you're away, Princess!"
Ai: "Hey, don't ignore me!"
Celica: "...They seem to be getting along over there,
so shall we go...?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Thora: "Oh, Princess Celica..."
Celica: "Huh? Oh... H-hello..."
Thora: "To think the Princess herself would come to the rescue..."
Celica: "Thank you for your help.
But I'm surprised you recognized me.
I don't think I make many public appearances."
Thora: "I once had the honor of seeing you
from a distance at a party."
Celica: "A party...?"
Arthur: "Come, we'd better get going.
We shouldn't fall too far behind schedule."
Celica: "There really isn't anyone here..."
Thora: "Shall I come with you?"
Arthur: "We'll be fine. I remember the mansion's layout,
so please wait here, Thora."
Thora: "Understood. Be careful."
Touya: "It really does seem deserted..."
Celica: "Shh. They might simply be in one of the rooms.
Be careful."
Arthur: "When I glanced up earlier, there was just one
window with bars on it.
There's a good chance the Prince is in there."
Clovis: "Do you know where it is?"
Arthur: "Yes. It's all in my head."
Touya: "Wow, you've memorized it? That's impressive."
Arthur: "Come on, let's go."
Touya: "Hey, isn't it a little too quiet?"
Arthur: "It is... But it doesn't feel
like a trap or anything."
Celica: "Arthur, isn't this the door?"
Arthur: "Oh, yes. This is it."
Clovis: "All right. Leave it to me."
Touya: "What are you going to do?"
Clovis: "What do you think? Unlock it, of course.
The locks here are the same type as in our world.
This'll be a piece of cake."
Clovis: "...Huh? It's unlocked..."
Celica: "Unlocked? Don't tell me... It's a trap?!"
Arthur: "...If it were, something would have happened
sooner. Let's go inside, anyway."
Clovis: "...There's no one he...!!"
?????: "...Wh-who's there?"
Celica: "That voice... Tix?!"
Tix: "Sis..."
Celica: "Tix... We've come to rescue you.
Come on, let's go home."
Celica: "Tix...?"
Tix: "I'm not going back.
I'm... going to find somewhere I belong.
The palace isn't where I belong..."
Touya: "Hey, come on."
Tix: "Cain is trying to use me.
But I don't care. At least he acknowledges me.
He really sees me..."
Celica: "!!"
Tix: "S-Sis...?"
Celica: "Enough of this self-pity!
They don't acknowledge you? Then work so hard
they can't find fault with you, and make them acknowledge you!
Nobody sees you? How can you say that?!
Lodis, and our late father and mother,
all saw you for who you were.
You're just taking your frustration at not getting your way
out on other people!"
Celica: "...I don't know what Cain said to you,
but you're my precious little brother. Isn't that enough?"
Tix: "Sis... I..."
Celica: "Everyone here came to rescue you.
You aren't alone."
Tix: "Sis..."
Celica: "Let's go home. Then fight on your own battlefield.
The one called the palace."
Tix: "Do you think... Lodis will forgive me?"
Celica: "Of course he will! If he says he won't,
I'll give him a smack next."
Tix: "Hehehehe... Thank you... Sis..."
Clovis: "Prince Tix, where's Cain?"
Tix: "He's been out since yesterday.
He said he'd be back today, though..."
Arthur: "Then we'd better leave here quickly."
Touya: "Yeah... Hm? What's that...?"
Tix: "Oh, that's Cain's mother.
Ricara Zea Isfandeil.
I hear she passed away last year..."
Touya: "She's beautiful."
Celica: "Come to think of it, he told me about her once.
He said she was the only person on his side..."
Arthur: "Well then, we'd better head back."
Touya: "Yeah. We'd be in trouble if he caught us
here."
Thora: "Then, let's go...!!"
Cain: "...Tix, I said you could move freely inside
the mansion, but I didn't say you could leave...
Where do you think you're going?"
Tix: "Cain... I..."
Cain: "Are you going back to that world of make-believe?
Come now, there's still time..."
Xiujian: "Leave this to me!"
Celica: "Let's hurry back!"
Thora: "I'll take you to Liebhofen!"
Celica: "Thank you..."
Kururu: "Aaaaaah!!"
Thora: "Kururu?!"
Arthur: "It's coming from the house!"
Thora: "Kururu!! What's wrong?! What..."
Touya: "Y-you bastard?!"
Clovis: "Oswald..."
Thora: "K-Kururu..."
Arthur: "So you're still alive..."
Touya: "You've got some nerve showing your face here!!"
Oswald: "...Everyone, it's been a while.
What happened to York was unfortunate, but I'm relieved
to see Her Majesty's wishes being carried on..."
Touya: "You bastard!"
Oswald: "Ah-ah, don't move.
Or this child's face will be scarred for life."
Arthur: "What are your demands?"
Oswald: "Hehehe... Straight to the point.
I have only one demand. Kill Cain, over there.
That's all."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Oswald: "You won't believe me even if I tell you,
but I never intended to kill the Princess... Queen Alforina...
But that man's... Cain's scheme,
that accursed 'Evil Eye' made me... The Princess...
W-with these hands... He was only using me!"
Clovis: "You expect us to believe that?"
Oswald: "I don't particularly expect you
to believe me. There's only one thing I want from you.
...Eliminate Cain. That's all."
Kururu: "Eek..."
Oswald: "Come on, hurry..."
Arthur: "...Touya, please go.
Clovis and I will handle things here."
Touya: "But..."
Clovis: "Don't worry."
Oswald: "Would you hurry up?"
Kururu: "Hic... Ugh... M-Mom..."
Thora: "...If you put even a single scratch on her...
I'll kill you..."
Oswald: "Ugh... Y-you're hardly...
I-in a p-position to say that..."
Thora: "...Would you like to find out? I am a knight's wife.
I have some training myself."
Oswald: "D-don't come closer!"
Kururu: "Ugh... H-help me..."
Thora: "Kururu..."
Touya: "You bastard...!"
Clovis: "...He means it. Touya, go! Hurry!"
Touya: "Damn... Sorry... I'm counting on you here!"
Clovis: "...Yeah."
Oswald: "H-heh, heh, hehehehehe..."
